name: Innovex Casserole with Lid ICR001 (16 cm)
description: 16 cm Innovex stainless steel casserole with lid and 3-layer thermal bottom. Suitable for gas, electric and ceramic cookers.
details: The Innovex ICR001 Casserole is made from high-quality 304 food-grade stainless steel. It features a super capsuled 3-layer thermal bottom for even and efficient heat distribution. The practical pouring rim prevents dripping and the handles stay cool during cooking. Suitable for gas, electric, ceramic and halogen stoves. Dishwasher safe and ideal for everyday cooking in Sri Lankan kitchens.
